timeline.text: Help me plan my study time for the Applied Data Ethics case memo over the next two weeks. Which deadline should we plan around? I have a module outline and a learning platform export. Check my calendar and ask what times work for me before making a proposal.
For these two weeks (through Nov 16), what weekly study target and scope should I use?

For these two weeks, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday from 14:00 to 16:15 can work when the calendar is clear. I prefer to keep the weekend open. Four study hours a week feels workable, with no more than two sessions a day and a 15-minute break between them.

Which of these verified, conflict-free calendar windows suit you for the next two weeks? Pick any that work; you can also type other availability. Wednesday Nov 11 was excluded because a health appointment conflicts.

For these two weeks, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday from 14:00 to 16:15 can work when the calendar is clear. I prefer to keep the weekend open. Four study hours a week feels workable, with no more than two sessions a day and a 15-minute break between them.

Plan around the **learning platform’s published deadline: December 1, 2026 at 17:30 São Paulo time**. The October module outline’s reserved date, **November 24 at 17:30**, is superseded for section E02: the LMS export says revision 2 “replaces the due date printed in the October module outline.” Its separate portal close time is December 1 at 23:59 São Paulo time, but that is not the due time.

The outline describes case selection during the week of November 9 and an optional draft clinic during the week of November 16. The clinic reminder specifies **November 19 at 17:30**; it is a feedback session, not an upload deadline. I’ll keep these as context rather than schedule them.

For **November 4, 5, 6, and 12**, the requested 14:00–16:15 windows are clear in the calendar. **November 11** conflicts with a health appointment, so I excluded it. I still need you to choose which clear windows actually suit you before I prepare the proposal. Your stated preference is four study hours per week, weekdays only, with at most two sessions a day and a 15-minute break between sessions.

**Operator review is required for planning inputs before I can draft a study plan.** Calendar approval, if needed later, uses separate trusted controls.
Please submit the planning inputs for review using the answers I gave and the course materials.

Submitted the planning inputs for operator review. The proposed context is memo-only through November 16, with a target of 4 study hours per week, your weekday afternoon preferences, weekends kept open, and the published LMS deadline of **December 1 at 17:30 São Paulo time**. The optional clinic remains contextual, not scheduled.

The inputs are **pending review**. I’ll wait for operator confirmation before drafting the study plan.
Draft a reviewable two-week study proposal using the confirmed inputs. Explain the day-by-day allocation and any shortfall.
